```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
```

# Datos de entrada

```{r importar}
calidad <- read.table(
  "calidad_26_cepas.tsv",
  header = TRUE, sep = "", quote = "", comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

calidad$cepa <- basename(calidad$file)
calidad$cepa <- sub("\\.fna$", "", calidad$cepa)
calidad$cepa <- sub("^[0-9]+_", "", calidad$cepa)

numeric_cols <- c("num_seqs", "sum_len", "min_len", "avg_len", "max_len", "N50", "GC(%)")
for (x in numeric_cols) calidad[[x]] <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", calidad[[x]]))

kmer <- read.table(
  "results/kmer_summary_by_strain.tsv",
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "", comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kmer$cepa <- sub("^[0-9]+_", "", kmer$StrainID)
```

# Métricas de ensamblaje

```{r tabla-calidad}
tabla <- calidad[, c("cepa", "num_seqs", "sum_len", "N50", "GC(%)")]
colnames(tabla) <- c("Cepa", "Contigs", "Longitud_total_bp", "N50_bp", "GC_percent")
kable(tabla, digits = 2)
```

```{r n50, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot(calidad, aes(x = reorder(cepa, N50), y = N50)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2C7FB8") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "N50 (bp)", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r longitud, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot(calidad, aes(x = reorder(cepa, sum_len), y = sum_len)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#7B3294") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Longitud total (bp)", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r contigs, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot(calidad, aes(x = reorder(cepa, num_seqs), y = num_seqs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#008837") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Número de contigs", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r gc, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot(calidad, aes(x = reorder(cepa, `GC(%)`), y = `GC(%)`)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E08214") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GC (%)", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

# K-mers únicos por cepa

```{r kmer-unicidad, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot(kmer, aes(x = reorder(cepa, Mean_Percent_Unique), y = Mean_Percent_Unique)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#1B9E77") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Unicidad promedio (%)", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r kmer-total, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
ggplot(kmer, aes(x = reorder(cepa, Nunique_total), y = Nunique_total)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#D95F02") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "K-mers únicos acumulados", title = NULL, subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

# Resumen de la preparación

```{r resumen-global}
global <- read.table(
  "results/kmer_summary_global.tsv",
  header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(global) <- c("Metrica", "Valor")
kable(global, col.names = c("Métrica", "Valor"))
```

La ejecución de `PreProcessR` terminó correctamente. La comparación de lecturas y la estimación de abundancias corresponden a la Fase 2 y se ejecutan con el script `scripts/10_run_strainr.sh` cuando estén disponibles los archivos FASTQ.
